policy.child_definition_rule: K1.1 through K1.4 remain the sole definition authorities for their rows. K1.5 stores typed references and joins only; a repeated child ID is never a second obligation definition.
policy.input_pin_rule: Every child artifact, companion document, and checked-in contract source is pinned by exact repository bytes, logical-record count, and SHA-256.
policy.shared_input_rule: When child packets pin the same path, every observed SHA-256 must agree. A missing pin or a second hash for one path is a blocking conflict.
policy.obligation_rule: The seven K1.1 obligation domains partition exactly 279 typed rows. Missing, extra, duplicate, conflicting, or unowned rows keep the incumbent.
policy.evidence_rule: Unit, executable model, property, fuzz, independent, and real-service vectors are separate required evidence classes. Planned, static, local-model, wire-only, compile-only, NOT_RUN, UNKNOWN, BLOCKED, or silent-skip state is never execution evidence.
policy.protocol_rule: Only rows explicitly typed MESSAGE_SET or CONFIG_MAPPING by the accepted child or K1.5 adjudication may claim protocol bindings. LOCAL_ONLY, ABSENT_GAP, INVENTORY_ONLY, and REFERENCE_ONLY rows must not acquire invented Kafka messages.
policy.typed_binding_adjudication_rule: K1.2 binding-group membership is historical input, not semantic proof. K1.5 must type each corrected row as MESSAGE_SET, CONFIG_MAPPING, LOCAL_ONLY, INVENTORY_ONLY, or REFERENCE_ONLY and must retain every displaced coarse reference in the conflict ledger.
policy.state_owner_rule: Every accepted route names a typed state-owner role separately from implementation and evidence roles; no effect, resource, residue, generation, offset, transaction, or delivery state may be ownerless. If state_owner reuses any route-local unit, model, property, or fuzz owner ID, an explicit overlap reason is required. Sharing among non-state evidence roles is permitted and never collapses independent or real-service ownership.
policy.coexistence_rule: The incumbent remains the only production path. Future native observation requires an explicit isolated mode owned by K14 and may not narrow the public no-feature or feature=kafka surfaces.
policy.shadow_rule: Offline-pure, broker-read, resource-construction-observe-only, isolated-side-effecting, duplicate-forbidden, and non-comparable operations are distinct. No side-effecting request or resource construction may be duplicated against the same production identity or namespace.
policy.rollback_rule: Ambiguous broker-visible outcomes are reconciled by their named owner before retry, replay, identity reuse, or incumbent resumption. Rollback never means blind duplicate execution.

lineage_and_conflict_ledger.join_identity_rule: artifact_id, bead_id, capability_id, ADR ID, exact input pins, and typed row IDs define the join. program_id is a producer lineage label and is never an obligation key.
